node.title: KoalaBear m12 r4 low-genus branch-profile reduction
node.closure: Riemann-Hurwitz genus cut plus complete tame degree-five branch-cycle enumeration
node.statement: For the inner-degree-12 transverse type (r,delta)=(4,12), the actual component's birational bidegree-(2,4) model has normalization genus at most three. Riemann-Hurwitz forces the outer component to have genus at most one. Complete tame S_5 branch-cycle enumeration leaves exactly five profiles: A5 with (3),(2,2) or (3),(3), and S5 with (2),(3,2), (2),(4), or (2),(2),(2,2). Tame polynomial AGL(1,5) and the genus-two and genus-three profiles are impossible. No surviving profile, r4, m12, owner, charge, u2, cap 68, or row close is claimed.
